name: Legends
overview: The Scriptures emphasize the importance of internalizing God's commands and teaching them diligently to the next generation, as seen in Deuteronomy 6:6-7 and 11:18-19. These commands are to be kept in the heart, spoken of continually throughout daily life, and symbolically bound on the hand and forehead, as well as written on doorposts and gates, signifying a constant remembrance and visible testimony of faith. This practice highlights the seriousness of God's Word and the call for believers to live in obedience and remembrance of His precepts.
